title: I need of some REALLY good movies / tv shows to watch. Just found this sub and I'm impressed with what you guys have to say!

commenti.body:
Alright. I’ll give you a couple, and also give you a spoiler free overview of the atmosphere and type of vibe you should expect from each. A humble opinion, but I think you’ll enjoy these given the list you provided. 

I can see a mix of abstract and more surreal films mixed with hyper-realist films and shows (particularly Succession and Sopranos). So I’ll give a mix of those two. 

If you like that hyper realist feel: The Wire is a must watch for any TV enthusiast. Forget the memes, this is one of the greatest documentations of the drug trade ever put to fiction. Also; Generation Kill, and Show Me a Hero, are two miniseries made by the same creators of The Wire and have thus are good appetizers if you want a shorter series before starting a 5 season show. 

(Also, Mad Men because it’s one of my favs). 

If you like abstract surrealist feel: Twin Peaks. That’s it. Watch Twin Peaks S1, S2. Then Fire Walk with Me, and then The Return. If you’ve seen Lynch, you already know what to expect. If not, go in blind. Maybe watch Blue Velvet beforehand, then Eraserhead (both films). But go in blind.

Hope that helps!!
